requirements.desc: A stale test evidence recovery after a material implementation change shall create or resume one TestEvidenceRefreshPurpose transaction whose manifest hash, ledger tail currentHash, delta currentHash, and reported currentFingerprint equal the current repair fingerprint.
requirements.note: R1: committed refresh aligns manifest ledger delta and result fingerprint

requirements.desc: When an impl-repair ledger already exists, the refresh entry shall append exactly once with previousHash equal to the prior ledger tail currentHash, a non-empty changed-path delta, and invalidation records equal to the transaction's staged artifact set.
requirements.note: R2: refresh appends one continuous ledger entry after retry

requirements.desc: Integration gate, final-regression, and acceptance-review stale evidence entrypoints shall delegate lifecycle transition and repair effects to the same existing impl-repair transaction authority without adding another mutation owner.
requirements.note: R3: every stale entrypoint uses the owned lifecycle transition authority

requirements.desc: Recovery shall report success only after the owned transaction has committed its delta, ledger, manifest, artifact invalidation, and test-execute lifecycle transition, and no consumer shall accept a pending or partially applied transaction as current evidence.
requirements.note: R4: failed effects remain pending and never report recovered success

requirements.desc: A retry after each injected durable failure boundary shall either roll the identical owned transaction forward exactly once or fail closed; it shall not duplicate ledger entries, lose stale artifacts without a committed transition, or return a partial recovered result.
requirements.note: R5: every durable effects boundary converges exactly once

requirements.desc: Valid evidence already matching the current fingerprint shall retain its normal path, while malformed evidence, inconsistent fingerprints, foreign pending transactions, changed material authority, and run/spec/Issue target mismatches shall fail closed without recovery mutation.
requirements.note: R6: changed target identity rejects a pending refresh without mutation

requirements.desc: After committed recovery, the normal flow shall regenerate current evidence through test-execute, test-result-review, impl-review, impl-gate, retro, and acceptance-review without impl-repair ledger schema rejection.
requirements.note: R7: committed recovery regenerates evidence through the real CLI lifecycle

requirements.desc: The public recovery behavior of integration gate, final-regression, acceptance-review, and explicit rewind-test-evidence shall retain its existing result fields, next step, exact target guards, and fail-closed structural validation.
requirements.note: R8: public entrypoints preserve recovery projections and rewind guards

requirements.desc: Spec-local requirement tests and affected shared unit and CLI lifecycle tests shall cover existing-ledger continuity, all stale recovery entrypoints, durable failure boundaries, current evidence, malformed evidence, and target authority mismatches.
requirements.note: R9: affected shared recovery unit suites execute as regression evidence

request: Issue #458: Treat stale test evidence recovery after a material implementation change as one auditable formal repair transaction. Reuse TestEvidenceRefreshPurpose and the existing impl-repair transaction authority. Atomically keep the repair fingerprint manifest, impl-repair ledger tail, repair delta, artifact invalidation, and lifecycle reset consistent across final-regression, acceptance-review, and integration-gate entry points. Preserve fail-closed handling for intermediate, malformed, valid-current, and target-mismatch states; never report partial success after failure or crash injection. Verify ledger continuity and the normal regenerated lifecycle with shared unit and CLI regression tests. Out of scope: direct hash edits, manual artifact deletion, new mutation owners, and weakened acceptance-review validation.
